messages.subject: CIVIL | Rail, airports, roads and ESG stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear CIVIL Leadership Team,

CIVIL's portfolio across highways, rail systems, airports, dams and public works closely matches the kind of stakeholder-intensive project environment where my experience adds value.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities cover government and regulatory engagement, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy.

I manage formal approvals, regulator requests, public-institution interfaces and community-sensitive issues while coordinating action across technical and corporate teams. My recent energy-transition and carbon-governance work adds further relevance to infrastructure businesses operating under rising ESG expectations.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional roles across Corporate Affairs, Sustainability, Government Relations, Strategic Partnerships or project stakeholder leadership. I have attached a CIVIL-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
